statement: For every integer n>=1, every board B subset [n] x [n], and every d in {0,...,n}, define m_i, M_i and H_d exactly as in source.md and problem.md over every prime-power field. If H_d(B,x+1) is represented modulo x^3 on all x=q-1 by its unique integer polynomial c_0+c_1*x+c_2*x^2, then c_2>=0. This full-scope theorem is proved by a balanced-restriction convolution identity expressing the quadratic hit polynomial as the classical hit family convolved with coefficientwise nonnegative kernels supported on square boards of sizes 2,3,4. No global polynomiality or positivity of higher coefficients is asserted.
contribution: Proposed complete proof of the original quadratic positivity problem, extending the universal linear positivity theorem of Chen and Selover. The new algebraic locality-four reduction turns the infinite statement into an exact finite kernel certificate; two different complete evaluations agree for every board of size at most four. Fresh mathematical review and novelty assessment are pending.
